site.audience: fitness enthusiasts, newcomers to HIIT workouts, health-conscious adults aged 20-45

brief.title: RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World
brief.one_liner: A high-intensity interval training brand offering in-studio and digital workout experiences combining treadmill running and strength training.
brief.goal: Drive class bookings, promote the digital on-demand platform, showcase instructors, and convert first-time visitors into members through free trial offers and compelling workout descriptions.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page showcasing the brand promise, driving class bookings, and introducing both in-studio and digital workout options.
Explain the HIIT workout methodology, weekly class schedule by muscle group, and the unique studio experience to educate and convert visitors.
Showcase the team of fitness instructors with filtering by location, allowing users to learn about coaches and book classes with them.
Answer frequently asked questions about the spin/cycling class offering to inform potential participants.
Promote the on-demand digital workout platform, highlight its features, and drive free trial sign-ups.

interactions.trigger: User clicks left/right arrows or swipes on the lifestyle image carousel
interactions.expected: Carousel slides to the next or previous image with smooth transition

interactions.trigger: User clicks toggle between Floor and Treadmill options
interactions.expected: Content switches to show the selected workout format details

interactions.trigger: User selects a studio location from the filter dropdown
interactions.expected: Instructor grid filters to show only instructors at the selected location

interactions.trigger: User clicks on an FAQ question heading
interactions.expected: The answer expands below the question; other open answers collapse

interactions.trigger: User enters email and clicks subscribe button
interactions.expected: Form validates email input and shows a confirmation message

interactions.trigger: User clicks the country selector in the footer
interactions.expected: A dropdown or modal appears with available country/region options

data_display.description: A weekly schedule table showing which muscle group focus is assigned to each day of the week.
A filterable grid of instructor cards showing name, photo, home studio location, and a link to book a class.
An accordion-style FAQ list with expandable question-and-answer pairs about the cycling class format.

expected_content: World Class Workouts On Your Time
data_display.description: Feature highlights for the digital on-demand workout platform presented as content blocks.
